boxes.speaker: narrator
boxes.text: EPSILON CYGNI, 3089 AD. ALL LIFE ON THE EXOPLANET LYRA HAS BEEN OBLITERATED...

boxes.speaker: narrator
boxes.text: ...APART FROM THE HOLOSONIC VESSEL QNTM CNTRL. IT ESCAPES THE POISONOUS ATMOSPHERE, THE LEGACY OF AN ENTIRE CIVILIZATION STOWED ON BOARD...

boxes.speaker: narrator
boxes.text: ...A DNA-ENCRYPTED LIFEFORM! THE FINAL GIFT FROM THE DYING ELDERS, 15 MILLION ZETABYTES OF LYRA'S SACRED ETHNOLOGY, IMPRINTED INTO ITS CELLS, THE SACRED ENCRYPTION KNOWN AS THE OBLIVIOUS TRANSFER!

boxes.speaker: narrator
boxes.text: FOUR-DIMENSIONAL MANIFOLD ENABLED, QNTM CNTRL TRAVERSES THE EXPANSE OF CYGNUS A, INTO A SLINGSHOT THAT PROPELS IT INTO THE ORBIT OF AN UNKNOWN PLANET.

boxes.speaker: narrator
boxes.text: OUR FALLEN SHIP IS INTERCEPTED BY A SCOUT PATROL FROM AN ANCIENT TRIBE.

boxes.speaker: narrator
boxes.text: THEIR PLUNDER OF QNTM CTRL'S HOLD RETRIEVES URANIUM AND THE INVALUABLE CRYPTID, STILL DEEP IN HYPERSLEEP.

boxes.speaker: narrator
boxes.text: IN METABOLIC STASIS, THE PSYCHEDELIC VIBRATIONS OF THEIR BONFIRE RITUAL...

boxes.speaker: narrator
boxes.text: ...WOULD SOON TRIGGER OBTRAN TO BEGIN ITS DECODE PROTOCOL.
